name: Streaming Adaptive Tokenomics A Systems Engineering Approach To Programmable Incentive Des 6De14552B1
text: Adaptive Tokenomics argues that token projects lack an established field integrating economics, control theory, game theory, and constitutional design. This independently corresponds to Kaal's claim that productive decentralized networks require dynamic design, checks and balances, and game-theoretic incentives. The proposition is a field-level diagnosis, not evidence that any particular design keeps a network productive.
